title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.


What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or account/project management support.
  • Strong technology background.
  • Experience using AI to increase efficiency and automation.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with CRM’s, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and ChatGPT or similar tools.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and take ownership.
  • A professional home office setup suitable for professional video calls with executives.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and consistent availability during U.S. business hours with Central Time schedule.


Ideal Background

  • Three to five years of experience in operations or project management roles.
  • Longevity on your resume with the ability to articulate your success in similar roles.
  • Experience supporting executives or business owners in fast-paced environments.
  • Background in healthcare or executive recruiting is preferred but not required.


Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary paid in USD and based on experience.
  • Full-time remote position.
  • Central Time Schedule.
  • Performance-based growth opportunities available.

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.


Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:


  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).


Stack de IA e Ferramentas


  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Perfil Ideal

title: Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing
description:
Consultor(a) de Ativação de Marketing

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Visão Geral da Posição

O Consultor de Ativação de Marketing é responsável por configurar e executar campanhas de CRM e Loyalty no Salesforce Marketing Cloud , transformando estratégias de jornada em ações concretas por meio do uso avançado das funcionalidades da plataforma. Este cargo ativa jornadas de consumidor multi-etapas e multi-canais , aplicando regras de negócio, lógica de personalização e táticas de canal para entregar mensagens relevantes em grande escala.

Embora não seja responsável pelo desenvolvimento de backend ou automações técnicas , o profissional utiliza ferramentas nativas da plataforma (ex.: Journey Builder, Send Flows, Entry Criteria, Wait Steps, etc.) para executar campanhas de forma eficiente e precisa — sem necessidade de código . É necessário ter forte fluência nas capacidades de ativação self-service e trabalhar em estreita colaboração com leads de audiência, conteúdo e QA para garantir que todos os componentes estejam devidamente integrados.

Como especialista prático na configuração de jornadas e implantação de campanhas , este cargo permite que as marcas do setor entreguem comunicações consistentes, pontuais e de alto impacto via e-mail, push e outros canais próprios.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Direção de Marketing & Ativação

  • Traduzir estratégias de CRM e Loyalty em jornadas multi-etapas usando ferramentas self-service nativas da plataforma (ex.: funcionalidades drag & drop do SFMC).
  • Construir e lançar jornadas em E-mail, Push e SMS , incorporando lógica como wait steps, decision splits e regras de personalização baseadas nos objetivos da campanha.
  • Validar se todos os inputs necessários (ex.: audiências, templates, links, textos legais) estão completos e funcionais antes da ativação.
  • Monitorar jornadas ao vivo para detectar problemas de performance ou sinais operacionais (ex.: erros de audiência, falhas de lógica) e executar ajustes em tempo real quando necessário para garantir a integridade da execução .

Dados, Métricas & Otimização

  • Garantir a implementação correta da lógica de segmentação, critérios de entrada, tempos de espera e limites de frequência , alinhada à estratégia.
  • Marcar jornadas com IDs de campanha, metadados e parâmetros de rastreamento para suportar relatórios precisos.
  • Colaborar com o Analista de Performance & Insights para compartilhar observações da plataforma e validar os resultados das campanhas pós-lançamento.

Otimização de Processos de Campanha

  • Identificar lógicas repetitivas entre campanhas e propor estruturas modulares de jornada para aumentar a eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Manter documentação de melhores práticas de configuração de jornadas, checklists de QA de ativação e evolução dos padrões de execução.


Experiência e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência em operações de CRM, ativação de campanhas ou marketing de ciclo de vida, preferencialmente em organizações grandes e multi-mercado .
  • Experiência prática em lançamento e gestão de campanhas em plataformas como Salesforce Marketing Cloud ou ESPs equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento funcional profundo de módulos da plataforma: Journey Builder, Email Studio, Mobile Studio e Automation Studio .
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir estratégia em jornadas , utilizando wait steps, decision splits, filtros e lógica de conteúdo dinâmico .
  • Experiência em gerenciar calendários de campanhas complexos , com habilidade para lidar com várias ativações simultâneas em diferentes canais .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting , identificando e resolvendo problemas de configuração, falhas ou anomalias de performance de forma independente.
  • Alta atenção aos detalhes, orientação a processos e compromisso com a entrega impecável de campanhas .
  • Excelentes habilidades de colaboração para trabalhar com equipes de audiência, conteúdo, QA e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento em todas as camadas de execução.


Qualificações:

  • Certificações Salesforce Marketing Cloud (ex.: Email Specialist, Marketing Cloud Administrator ) são desejáveis.
  • Experiência em ativação de programas de loyalty, design de jornadas de ciclo de vida do cliente ou personalização em escala .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de QA de campanha e auditorias de execução .
  • Compreensão da lógica de dados (ex.: critérios de entrada, filtros de segmentação, lógica de exclusão) de um ponto de vista funcional, não de desenvolvimento .
  • Experiência em marketing digital, operações de marketing ou CRM em setores como CPG, varejo ou engajamento de consumidores em grande volume .


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test at XILO , a fast-growing AI-driven startup transforming the insurance industry. With 200+ clients, growing data, and fresh Series A funding, we’re scaling quickly — and we’re looking for someone to help us ensure quality and reliability at every step.

While your main focus will be automation, you’ll also support high-priority manual validation when needed.


You’ll take ownership of:

  • Leading CI/CD test integration and improving overall test stability and performance
  • Supporting critical release testing and mentoring engineers on writing integration/unit tests


What You’ll Bring:

  • ✔️ 5+ years of experience in software testing , with a strong focus on automation
  • ✔️ Deep knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript , and a track record of building resilient test systems
  • ✔️ Experience writing system-level and module-level E2E tests in a modern web platform
  • ✔️ Comfort working closely with developers and PMs to build test-first workflows
  • ✔️ Experience designing test strategies , introducing tools, and improving CI pipelines
  • ✔️ Bonus: Familiarity with Jest , Postman , Sonar , or performance/load testing tools


Why Join XILO?

  • ✅ A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact

A MetaQare busca médicos especialistas interessados em participar do programa internacional Authors of Clinical AI (ACAI) — a primeira rede global onde médicos transformam sua experiência clínica em inteligência médica aplicada , criando um legado que transcende gerações.

O objetivo é integrar conhecimento clínico real à medicina digital, promovendo inovação, segurança e acesso universal ao saber médico.

  • Interesse em tecnologia médica, inteligência artificial e inovação em saúde.

Mais informações: metaqare.ai/authors_of_clinical_ai.php



About MetaQare

For centuries, medicine has advanced through observation, experience, and human judgement.

Today, for the first time in history, we have the ability to amplify that clinical wisdom — beyond borders, beyond time, and beyond the limits of any single practitioner.

MetaQare was founded on a simple but powerful idea:

that the clinical wisdom of the world’s finest physicians should be accessible to every patient, everywhere.

This is not about replacing doctors —

it’s about enhancing their intelligence.

It’s about transforming clinical reasoning into a language that machines can understand, learn from, and scale — with ethics, precision, and transparency.

Every doctor who joins Authors of Clinical AI is not merely teaching an algorithm —

they are leaving their mark on the history of medicine.

For the first time, human knowledge becomes a living legacy ,

with a name, a signature, and a purpose.

MetaQare is not just building software —

it is building the collective intelligence of humanity in healthcare .

And we want you to be part of it.



Como participar

Os médicos selecionados farão parte do grupo inaugural de 100 especialistas que ajudarão a moldar o futuro da prática médica digital.

Seu conhecimento. Sua assinatura. Seu legado.

MetaQare marca o início de uma nova era —

a medicina, escrita por médicos.

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Analista de integração
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).

  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).


O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
  • Azure Functions

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

  • Representar a Apgar em eventos do ecossistema de dados/IA .


Perfil que buscamos

  • Hunter com histórico consistente de abertura de novos logos enterprise em serviços consultoria de dados/IA, governança, MDM ou plataformas de dados.
  • Linguagem de negócio + fluência técnica : fala com CDO/CIO/COO e também debate em bom nível com equipes de dados e governança (sem precisar ser “mão no código”).

Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Casos vendidos/entregues envolvendo MDM (Customer/Product 360) , Catálogo de Dados, Programas Governança , Databricks/Snowflake , AI/ML .
  • Vivência em metodologias de valor e roadmap (ex.: priorização esforço×impacto, MVP, “from business value to foundations & platform”).
  • Experiência com ApgarIA ou ofertas de AI para Operações (manufatura/supply chain, agentes de IA, otimização).


Como medimos sucesso (primeiros 6–12 meses)

  • Novos logos qualificados e fechados (mid-large/enterprise).

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) , you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO , you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities
  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL ) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging .
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications .
Qualifications
  • 5-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, EKS, SQS, IAM ).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS) .
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) , including performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and migration management.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi .
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI/CD ).
  • Proficiency in monitoring tools , specifically Zabbix , and logging solutions like Elastic Logging .
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or Go for automating operational tasks.
  • Experience working with Django-based applications in a cloud environment.
  • Experience implementing security best practices for cloud-based applications.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture .
Preferred Skills
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Experience with serverless computing and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with message queue services (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Understanding of zero-downtime deployments and disaster recovery strategies.
Position Details
  • Type: Full-Time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Hours: US Pacific Time hours
How to Apply

If you are passionate about scalability, automation, and reliability , and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and an optional brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MetaCTO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e evoluir o SOC , garantindo excelência em detecção, análise, resposta e contenção de incidentes de segurança. Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida liderando SOCs, operações 24x7 e Blue Team.

  • Forte domínio de EDR/XDR, NDR, IDS/IPS e firewalls.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Threat Hunting avançado, CTI, detecção comportamental.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful
  • Work with a fast-growing US-based performance agency that values craftsmanship and creativity.
  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: Senior Software Architect
description:
About Specialty Capital

Specialty Capital was founded just four years ago with a bold idea - to give “debanked” small businesses access to capital that’s Simple, Smart, and Reliable. Today, the company is among the top revenue-based finance companies in the U.S., serving thousands of merchants through a combination of speed, technology, and a deeply human approach. We’re now entering our next chapter and scaling into new financial verticals (credit cards, payments, and neo-bank integrations) and expanding internationally, starting with Canada. The company is profitable, founder-led, and growing rapidly with a culture built on grit, ownership, and mission.


Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to shape the technological foundation of our rapidly growing small business lending platform. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to design and implement cutting-edge financial technology solutions while working with a dynamic team focused on revolutionizing business financing. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in mobile application development and financial services technology to help us build scalable, secure, and innovative lending solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Strategy

  • Design and evolve the comprehensive technical architecture for our lending platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Define and maintain architectural standards, patterns, and best practices across all technology initiatives
  • Lead technology selection and evaluation processes for new tools, frameworks, and platforms
  • Create technical roadmaps aligned with business objectives and product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams

Mobile Application Architecture

  • Architect and oversee the development of native mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms
  • Design mobile solutions that deliver exceptional user experiences for loan applications and account management
  • Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services
  • Optimize mobile application performance and offline capabilities


Platform Development

  • Collaborate with SaaS vendors to ensure platform configurations align with architectural standards
  • Design and implement API strategies for internal and external integrations
  • Architect microservices and serverless solutions using cloud services
  • Develop architecture strategies for analytics, reporting, and machine learning
  • Implement AI and automation solutions to streamline lending processes


Security & Compliance

  • Define security architecture and implement defense-in-depth strategies
  • Ensure architectural compliance with financial industry regulations and standards
  • Design secure data handling and encryption strategies for sensitive financial information
  • Lead security reviews and threat modeling exercises
  • Implement monitoring and incident response architectures


Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical expertise in node.js, React, Swift, Java/Kotlin development
  • Review code, architectures, and technical designs to ensure quality and standards
  • Facilitate technical discussions and decision-making across teams
  • Establish development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technical practices

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • 10-15 years of progressive experience in software architecture and development
  • Required: Extensive experience in mobile application development for iOS and Android platforms
  • Strong expertise in Swift for iOS and Java/Kotlin for Android development
  • Proven experience with financial technology platforms and payment systems
  • Deep knowledge of cloud architecture
  • Experience with node.js, React, mySQL, and modern web technologies
  • Strong background in API design, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience with ETL processes, data pipelines, and reporting solutions
  • Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and financial services regulations
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in small business lending or commercial finance
  • Experience with Large Language Models / ML implementations in financial services
  • Knowledge of loan origination systems and credit decisioning platforms
  • Experience with React Native or cross-platform mobile development frameworks

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of a growing fintech company
  • Professional development opportunities and conference attendance
  • Collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and impact

Join Specialty Capital and play a pivotal role in revolutionizing small business lending through innovative technology solutions. As our Technical Architect, you'll have the opportunity to design systems that directly impact thousands of businesses across the country, helping them access the capital they need to grow and thrive.

Specialty Capital is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

description:

title: Professor de francês
description:

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Remote (Brazil-based)

Architecture & Design

Collaboration & Leadership

Core Technical Expertise

Cloud & DevOps

Monitoring & Observability

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with API security , OAuth2/JWT , and distributed caching (Redis, Elasticache).

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • A research-driven and pragmatic mindset with a focus on measurable outcomes.


Compensation


$20,000 – 40,000 / year depending on experience, expertise, and scope of ownership. This is a full-time role with significant responsibility and long-term upside.

Send the following to

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), arquiteturas modernas de apps móveis e integração com GraphQL.

Você será responsável por evoluir nossos aplicativos Android e contribuir na estrutura multiplataforma, garantindo alta performance, estabilidade e experiência de uso consistente.

Procuramos alguém com sólido domínio técnico, mentalidade de produto, e visão arquitetural, capaz de entregar soluções escaláveis e manuteníveis em um ambiente colaborativo e ágil.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações mobile Android com Kotlin e Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) , compartilhando código entre plataformas quando aplicável.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas escaláveis e reativas (Clean Architecture, MVVM, MVI).
  • Integrar com APIs GraphQL de forma eficiente e segura.
  • Assegurar performance, estabilidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Escrever código limpo, modular e testável , com atenção à manutenibilidade e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Garantir qualidade de software com testes automatizados (unitários, instrumentados e end-to-end).
  • Participar ativamente de discussões de arquitetura , code reviews e decisões técnicas .
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers e engenheiros backend para construir experiências consistentes e de alto impacto.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida com Kotlin e desenvolvimento Android nativo (Jetpack, Compose, Coroutines, Flow).
  • Vivência prática em Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) e Ktor para compartilhamento de código entre plataformas.
  • Domínio de arquiteturas modernas (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture).
  • Integração com APIs GraphQL .
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Espresso, Kaspresso, MockK).
  • Conhecimento sólido em injeção de dependência (Hilt, Koin).


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Conhecimento em Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile (KMM) com integração iOS.
  • Experiência em consumo offline-first (Room, SQLDelight, caching).
  • Vivência com Compose Multiplatform .
  • Conhecimento em design system e componentização cross-platform .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em aplicações de grande escala e alto tráfego .
  • Participação em times ágeis com forte cultura de engenharia e DevOps.


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.

description:

Domínio de Power BI (modelagem de dados, DAX, otimização de performance e design de dashboards).

Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL para manipulação e extração de dados em bancos relacionais.

Experiência com linguagem de programação SAS (Enterprise Guide ou similares) ou Python (bibliotecas como pandas, numpy, matplotlib ou seaborn) para tratamento e análise de dados.

Experiência com estruturas de dados volumosas e complexas, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos.

Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas.

Experiência no mercado segurador ou financeiro.

Conhecimento em modelagem estatística e técnicas de machine learning.

Habilidade em storytelling com dados e apresentação executiva de resultados.

title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.


● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.


● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.


Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).


JOB REQUIREMENTS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).


Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

● Proven experience with data modeling tools, preferably Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler.

● Solid knowledge of Data Governance tools for Catalog, Lineage, and Quality, preferably the Informatica suite (IDMC/Axon/EDC).

● In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and its application in data architectures.

● Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.


● Knowledge of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, and Business Intelligence concepts. Behavioral Competencies (Soft Skills)

● Analytical Vision: Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.

● Assertive Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences (technical and business).

● Organization and Focus: Discipline to manage multiple projects and priorities autonomously.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.

title: Gerente de planejamento comercial
description:
Vaga: Gerente de Planejamento Comercial

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, RJ


Estruturar e gerenciar o planejamento estratégico das coleções, liderando a equipe de especialistas, analistas e assistentes de planejamento com foco no ciclo de vida do produto e na otimização do merchandising.

O profissional será responsável por garantir a assertividade do mix de produtos, gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) e otimizar os níveis de estoque, visando maximizar as vendas, o giro e a rentabilidade do negócio, enquanto desenvolve e orienta seu time.


Principais Responsabilidades


1. Planejamento de Produto e Coleção (Pré-Temporada):

  • Análise de Performance: Supervisionar a análise de dados históricos de vendas (curva de produtos, categorias, atributos) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e riscos.
  • Construção do OTB (Open-to-Buy): Desenvolver e gerenciar o orçamento de compras (OTB) por coleção e categoria, alinhado às metas financeiras da companhia.
  • Definição do Sortimento (Mix): Liderar as discussões com as áreas de Estilo e Compras para definir a arquitetura da coleção (pirâmide de produtos, mix, amplitude vs. profundidade).
  • Planejamento de Demanda: Garantir a acuracidade do forecast de vendas e da projeção de necessidades de compra (compra inicial vs. reposição).

2. Planejamento de Merchandising (Durante a Temporada):

  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar e direcionar o time na análise da performance do estoque (cobertura, giro, sell-through) e no gerenciamento do fluxo de produtos.
  • Alocação e Abastecimento: Definir e supervisionar a estratégia de distribuição inicial (alocação) e o plano de reposição (abastecimento) para as lojas e canais.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida: Orientar a equipe na identificação de produtos (Best Sellers, Slow Movers) e liderar a proposição de ações comerciais (promoções, remarcações) para otimizar o ciclo de vida.
  • Planejamento de Liquidação: Estruturar a estratégia de markdown (remarcação) ao final da coleção, visando a limpeza do estoque com o mínimo impacto na margem.

3. Gestão de Equipe e Performance:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas e planejadores, orientando as entregas diárias e promovendo o crescimento profissional do time.
  • Gestão de Desempenho: Definir metas e KPIs para a equipe, acompanhando a performance individual e coletiva através de feedbacks e planos de desenvolvimento.
  • Controle de Qualidade: Assegurar a precisão, a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos de todas as entregas, relatórios e análises da área.
  • Consolidação de KPIs: Ser o guardião dos indicadores de planejamento (Giro, Cobertura, Sell-Through, Margem, GMROI), consolidando os resultados e criando planos de ação.
  • Interface Estratégica: Liderar a interface e atuar como o principal ponto de contato entre as áreas de Compras, Estilo, Logística e Vendas, garantindo o alinhamento do planejamento.


Requisitos Essenciais


  • Experiência: Sólida experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercial, Produto ou Merchandising, adquirida obrigatoriamente no Varejo de Moda.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: Comprovada experiência em gestão de equipes (supervisão, coordenação ou gerência), mesmo que de times pequenos.
  • Competências Técnicas:
  • Domínio avançado em Excel (modelagem, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas).
  • Profundo conhecimento em gestão de OTB (Open-to-Buy).
  • Ampla vivência com os principais indicadores de varejo (KPIs) e do ciclo de vida do produto.
  • Perfil:
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e desenvolver pessoas.
  • Perfil altamente analítico, estruturado e com forte raciocínio lógico.
  • Habilidade de transformar dados complexos em insights acionáveis.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociar e influenciar áreas parceiras.
  • Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Moda (com foco em Negócios) ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais (Desejável)


  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Varejo, Finanças ou Negócios ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experiência com planejamento em múltiplos canais (Omnichannel - Lojas Físicas e E-commerce).

title: VMware Administrator
description:
VMware Engineer (Remote – EST Hours)

Schedule: 40h/week • On-call rotation required

Contract: Contractor


About the Role

Our client is looking for an experienced VMware Engineer to join our infrastructure team, supporting large-scale virtualized environments and ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across global data centers.

The ideal professional has strong hands-on experience with vSAN , VMware cluster management, upgrades, and networking at the hypervisor level.


Key Responsibilities

Virtualization & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and support VMware ESXi and vCenter environments (versions 7 and 8; migration to 9 planned).
  • Manage VMware clusters, VMware Distributed Switches (VDS), and ESXi host configurations.
  • Perform vCenter and ESXi upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure optimal configuration, performance, and availability of virtual infrastructure.

vSAN (Mandatory)

  • Manage and support VMware vSAN environments (minimum 2 years of hands-on experience).
  • Monitor vSAN health, performance, and storage capacity.
  • Troubleshoot vSAN-related storage, performance, and node issues.

Networking & System Administration

  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port groups, and VM networking issues.
  • Understand network configuration at the hypervisor level and how to troubleshoot VM connectivity.
  • Integrate and manage Active Directory within vCenter environments.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with VMware vSAN (must-have).
  • 5+ years of experience administering VMware environments (versions 7 and 8).
  • Hands-on expertise in:
  • VMware Cluster & VDS Management
  • vSAN configuration and maintenance
  • ESXi host upgrades and patching
  • vCenter lifecycle management
  • Understanding of VLANs, trunks, and virtual networking.
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory integration in vCenter.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in complex virtualized environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large enterprise VMware environments.
  • Familiarity with automation or scripting tools (PowerCLI, Python).
  • Knowledge of backup/restore strategies in virtual infrastructures.


Work Environment

  • Remote role aligned to EST business hours (8:30 AM–5:30 PM) .
  • Includes on-call rotation for critical support needs.
